szoveg_eredeti:
Just minutes ago, I had the pleasure to announce Llama for Windows during the .NET conf keynote, thanks Luis Quintanilla and Microsoft for having me!

Llama for Windows brings Local AI to the people.
Your AI. On your PC. Easy and free. 
Fully private. No terminal, no set up. 
App is open source, and powered by llama.cpp 

Download it today at llama.app - and soon from the Windows Store!

Congrats Morgan Funtowicz Georgi Gerganov and team for the launch.

prioritas.lead_hu: A Hugging Face a Microsoft .NET konferenciáján bejelentette a Llama for Windows alkalmazást. Az nyílt forráskódú eszköz segítségével a felhasználók közvetlenül a saját PC-jükön futtathatnak AI-modelleket.
